data.description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

 

💡 Your Mission: Build the financial engine for our next stage of growth

As an AI-Native Finance Manager, you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally.

This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering. You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions.

At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function. You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements.

We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them — someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better.

 

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize.

  • Drive financial reporting and analysis, building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions.

  • Own and improve operational finance processes, including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation.

  • Build and improve our Finance stack, connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work.

  • Support our international growth, working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations.

     

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role, with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience.

  • Strong analytical and commercial thinking, with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations.

  • A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable.

  • Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently.

  • Modern finance systems & tools: Hands-on experience working with ERP/accounting systems and modern Finance tools. Experience with Spendesk, BI/reporting tools, or workflow automation platforms is a plus.

  • High ownership and a builder mentality: you are comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, communicating with stakeholders, and building processes from scratch. Fluent in English and conversational in German.

     

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

  • Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

  • Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

  • You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

 

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you – no matter who you are or what background you have!

data.title: UVC Partners: Junior Value Creation Analyst - Intern or Working Student (f/m/d)
data.description:
Über uns

UVC Partners backs Europe’s most ambitious B2B tech founders building new category leaders with more than
€800m in assets under management. From DeepTech to AI, the firm has invested in breakout startups including
Isar Aerospace, Proxima Fusion, Q.ANT, Aleph Alpha, Tacto, Flix, and FINN. UVC Partners' Value Creation team is a team of experts whose core mission is to create measurable impact for our portfolio companies by giving them unique access to industry leaders through a structured, proactive approach. Deeply rooted in UnternehmerTUM, Europe's leading startup and business innovation ecosystem, the team builds actionable relationships between our portfolio companies and a network of 1,000+ corporates as potential customers and strategic partners - and turns those relationships into real business outcomes.


Deine Aufgaben

Value Creation is not a side show at UVC Partners. We are looking for an outstanding individual to join us to work within our Value Creation team to open doors for our startups they couldn’t open alone. What you will contribute, starting in week two:

  • Sales Enablement – You will support our founders directly with business development topics. You research who holds the budget inside a target corporate, find the path there through our network, and write the intro email
  • Corporate Partnerships – You prepare sessions with our industrial partners, join the room, and document what comes out of them. You will be talking to people twenty years your senior
  • Knowledge Management – Our founders ask the same questions again and again (pricing, first sales hires, KPI reporting). You own your own topic streams and turn them into something a founder can apply in ten minutes
  • Data Management – Our Salesforce is the memory of the fund. You keep it clean and build the analyses and AI-supported workflows that save the team hours with Claude and Notion

How to apply:
Please apply by uploading your CV, transcripts, and one page of max. 350 words answering all three questions below:
1. Pick one of our portfolio companies and name a concrete target customer for them. Which company, which role inside it, and how would you get to that person? Three or four sentences are enough.
2. Which technological development interests you most right now – and what speaks against it? We want the counterargument as much as the enthusiasm.
3. Which book would you give a founder in their first month, and why? No obligatory business classics. An honest answer beats an impressive one.

Write it yourself. If you used AI, tell us in one sentence what for.


Dein Profil

  • You are currently enrolled in a Master's degree program with excellent results at a top-tier university - We are open to all types of educational backgrounds (e.g., engineering, science, business, finance, etc.)
  • You have previously worked in a fast-paced environment (startups, VC/PE, consulting, or similar)
  • You bring hands-on experience with AI tools; first experience working with Salesforce is also a plus
  • You are deeply passionate about startups, technology, and innovation
  • You are collaborative, empathetic, and communicative - a true team player
  • You have a high level of intellectual curiosity as well as a self-starter and growth mindset
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English and German
  • You are available for this position either full-time for 5–6 months or part-time (20h/week) for at least 12 months


Deine Vorteile

  • Ownership – You will work on your own impactful projects from day one to contribute to the growth and success of our portfolio companies
  • Important member of the team – You will be part of the Value Creation team where you will get direct access to our outstanding founders
  • Mentorship – Be paired with one senior member of our team with regular 1-to-1 sessions
  • Venture Capital trainee program – Take part in the condensed apprenticeship program that gives you the details on how to excel in the venture capital industry – as an investor or a founder
  • Free sports classes – Join our weekly, free of charge classes in the office in Munich 
  • Network – Be part of the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem to equip you with perspectives and contacts to leapfrog your startup career
  • Sustainability – Get to know the next generation of sustainable startups that are changing the world we live in
  • Competitive salary – You receive a competitive salary package and will have the flexibility to align your studies with our day-to-day operations


Vielfalt ist uns wichtig

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Kontakt

Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

Join our growing FinTech Engineering team! We're recruiting another Software Engineering Team Lead to join Asset Sales team.

The Impact

Your architecture will directly shape how millions of people access credit for the first time. We've already served 10 million customers and unlocked more than $2 billion in credit since we began. 🌱 Environmental impact: We're carbon-negative, having avoided 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions across our product portfolio.

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll lead a team of backend engineers through both greenfield and legacy projects, owning the full software lifecycle from design ideation through to production and eventual decommissioning. Our engineering teams work under a true DevOps culture — with infrastructure as code, observability, automated testing, and continuous delivery treated as first-order concerns, not afterthoughts.

You'll set architectural direction, partner closely with your Product Manager counterpart on roadmap planning and prioritisation, and serve as a servant leader who grows the people around you while shipping high-quality, impactful software.

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • Continuous improvement: We foster a culture of innovation within a supportive, dynamic team environment.

  • Product partnership: Engineering and Product work as genuine counterparts — planning together, prioritising together, delivering together.

What You Need

We're looking for an experienced, low-ego engineering leader who brings both technical depth and a genuine passion for growing people.

Join our expanding Product Growth team! We're actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. You'll build and scale the lifecycle systems that drive retention, upsell, and customer lifetime value for millions of everyday earners across Africa.

You'll design the retention and upsell infrastructure that turns first-time customers into long-term, high-value ones, driving measurable CLV growth while creating financial inclusion for Africa's traditionally excluded. data.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Highlight the most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

As Director of Engineering, you are responsible for building the organisation that makes Hawk-Eye's Performance & Insight products easy to build, scale, maintain.

Your mission is to build a lean organisation with AI at the heart of it, capable of scaling through technology. Your organisation addresses the needs of top-tier sport clients - clubs, leagues, federations - seeking access to data and insights to unlock the next level of performance.

You will lead and manage a ~50 people strong organisation, including web/mobile/data/cloud engineering. You will aim to scale the organisation and productivity with AI delegation patterns wherever possible.

Team Leadership and Management

  • Build and lead a high-calibre Product & Engineering function with strong technical credibility and operational judgement.

  • Hire, develop, and align engineering leaders and specialists across sports and disciplines within P&I

  • Foster a culture of accountability, clarity, calm execution, and continuous improvement.

  • Act as a senior internal leader who can bring structure to complexity without becoming bureaucratic.

Engineering Standards and Shared Ways of Working

  • Create practical standards to enable strong reliability, platform quality, operational readiness, and shared data governance across the whole of Hawk-Eye’s engineering.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders so shared platform and data standards improve delivery speed.

Operational Leadership

  • Identify systemic reliability risks, fragile dependencies, and operational bottlenecks early, and drive resolution.

  • Introduce visible service health, ownership, and numeric baselines for the critical systems under your remit.

  • Use major tournaments, flagship customers, and real operating pressure as proving grounds for improved resilience and trust.

  • Transition the P&I organisation to structured and disciplined operational management.

Enabling AI-Ready Foundations

  • Build the platform, data, and governance conditions required for AI-enabled software delivery to scale safely.

You want to make a difference in the world of sports, and HawkEye is your vehicle to do it.

You are a strong technology leader with real experience building data-driven product capabilities in organisations where reliability, scale, and coordination matter.
You join HawkEye with the know-how in creating the ownership, standards, operating discipline, and trust that make good engineering practices useful in practice.

You are credible with senior engineers, comfortable in operationally demanding environments, and able to move between cloud infrastructure, data foundations, organisational design, and delivery reality without losing the plot.
You know how to centralise what must become shared capability without hollowing out the autonomy and judgement of teams that build on top of it.

You care about engineering quality, but you care just as much about business consequence. You know that reliability protects customer trust, governed data creates leverage, and shared standards only matter when they make the organisation materially better at delivering outcomes.

GTM Engineer
data.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Go-To-Market at LILT

Go-to-market at LILT is our strategic growth engine. Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Revenue Operations run together. We're responsible for telling LILT's story and what makes us different from other translation options in the market. We tell that story to the world with effective demand generation programs, and we turn it into revenue through the outbound and inbound motions our reps run every day. We're shaping how people understand LILT's brand, product, and the category we're building.

We're expert storytellers and operators who work across the entire funnel, from awareness to conversion to expansion. We partner closely with Product and Customer Success to drive pipeline, accelerate adoption, and position LILT as the market leader in enterprise AI translation.

This role has a cross-functional mandate by design. The systems that matter most right now sit on the Sales and RevOps side as much as the Marketing side: Account routing, the lead-to-opportunity process, ADR-facing tooling, signal scanning for the reps. You'll have explicit standing to audit, redesign, and rebuild AI workflows across all of our growth systems.

We're building a world-class team and we're looking for ambitious, curious people who want to grow fast, work with seasoned operators, and help shape the future of AI and language.

Whether it's crafting compelling narratives, launching new capabilities, running high-impact campaigns, or engineering the systems underneath all of it, we move fast, think big, and care deeply about quality. If you're excited about AI, language, and building a category-defining company, you'll thrive here. It's a place to work if you want to have a real impact, learn a ton, working hands-on building content, campaigns, programs, and systems you can be proud of.

GTM Engineering at LILT

As LILT scales, more of our go-to-market motion is powered by agentic AI, systems that can research, enrich, sequence, and act on our behalf, not just report on what already happened. This role sits at the center of that shift. You'll be the builder who turns "we should automate this" into a working, reliable system, owning the tools and automations that keep Marketing, Sales, and RevOps running smoothly.

Examples of the kinds of systems that live in this role:

  • AI-driven meeting and lead qualification agents that compile evidence from across our stack to make a judgment

  • Account signal-scoring systems that combine data into a ranked, defensible view of where the team should spend its time

  • AI-drafted outbound at scale, personalized from live account context

These are illustrative rather than a fixed backlog. The specific builds will change; the shape of the work won't.

Where You'll Work

This role is based in our London office. We work in a hybrid model, with team members in the office 3 days per week to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. You'll get the energy and creativity of in-person work, combined with the flexibility to focus from home when needed.

What You'll Do

This high-impact, hands-on role is responsible for owning LILT's agentic GTM systems: proposing, designing, building, and maintaining the AI-driven tools and automations that power our go-to-market engine, including our Clay-based enrichment and outbound workflows. You'll also play a critical role in optimizing our go-to-market technology stack, streamlining our lead-to-opportunity process, and helping to maintain day-to-day department operations.

You'll work closely with GTM leadership across Sales Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations and Systems functions to drive process optimization and overall efficiency. You'll recommend, build, and run cross-functional projects and process improvements that directly impact our operational efficiency and top-line growth of all revenue lines. You'll contribute to the strategy and execution of full-funnel programs that drive predictable, scalable pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agentic business systems integration. Propose, design, build, and maintain agentic AI tools and automations that connect and orchestrate our GTM stack end-to-end, reducing manual work and increasing the speed and reliability of our lead-to-revenue motion.

  • Own Clay and the automation stack. Serve as our resident expert on Clay (and similar enrichment/orchestration tools), building and maintaining tables, waterfalls, and workflows that keep our data accurate and our outbound motion running.

  • Salesforce lead-to-opportunity. Partner closely with RevOps to own the workflow from a new lead entering the system, through the various lead stages, and converting to an opportunity, including routing, assignment, and the rules that decide who works what.

  • Full-funnel ownership. Design and optimize the entire lead funnel, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL to SQL handoff, driving higher conversion and increased velocity.

  • Lead and contact data integrity. Work with internal tools and external vendors to maintain a high quality database of contacts across our target industries and personas.

  • Partner with Sales. Align tightly with revenue leadership to define pipeline goals, campaign targeting, SLAs, and lead management workflows. Sit close enough to the reps to know which parts of the process actually hurt.

  • Fuel growth. Partner closely with the demand gen team to drive multi-channel campaigns across email marketing, webinars, paid media, SEO, events, outbound motions, and ABM to meet ambitious growth targets.

  • Use data to scale. Build a data-driven culture. Forecast, measure, and communicate program results, continuously optimizing for ROI and CAC efficiency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work across demand gen, product marketing, ADRs, and sales ops to build cohesive, conversion-optimized systems and campaigns.

  • Department operations. Help with department-level planning for things like managing campaign budget, team meetings and activities, and annual planning.

  • Documentation and knowledge continuity. Maintain living documentation (Notion) for every agent and workflow you own, to a standard where a new team member or another AI agent could pick up ownership without a live handover call. This is a stated expectation of the role, not an afterthought.

Our Stack

  • CRM and RevOps: Salesforce, Default

  • Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo

  • Outbound and conversation intelligence: Amplemarket, Trellus

  • Inbound and web conversion: Qualified

  • Marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Analytics: GA4, Salesforce reporting, Looker Studio

  • Build environment: Python, LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, Notion for documentation

Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years in B2B SaaS or AI/ML go-to-market engineering, RevOps, or marketing operations, with a track record of building automations that actually ship.

  • Hands-on Clay expertise. You've built waterfall enrichment, scoring, and routing in Clay (or a comparable tool), and you can take a new use case from idea to live quickly.

  • Agentic AI and automation fluency. Comfortable proposing, designing, and building agentic workflows and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and orchestration tools, to connect systems and eliminate manual work.

  • Working proficiency in Python/other languages for building and maintaining AI agent pipelines. Comfortable working inside an existing codebase, not just writing standalone scripts.

  • Comfortable reasoning about tradeoffs under cost and token constraints. You can explain not just what you built, but why you didn't build the more expensive or more complex version.

  • Strong Salesforce fundamentals. You can build reports, understand the object model and the automation layer, and use what you find to change how the funnel actually performs.

  • A point of view on where AI in GTM is heading. We'll ask. We're less interested in whether we agree than in whether you've thought about it seriously.

  • Obsessed with the metrics that matter: MQLs, pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, velocity, CAC, and ROI.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar) a plus.

  • Ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally.

  • Smart, curious, and hard-working.

  • Natural collaborator and communicator, comfortable presenting to executives, boards, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

About us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment. We are filling a W2-Professorship in Business Information Systems, Business Analytics and Applied AI (100 %).


Your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Bachelor's program in Digital Business and Transformation, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on business information systems, business analytics, applied artificial intelligence and data engineering in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and bachelor's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of business analytics, applied artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision-making – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration


Recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):

  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of business information systems, computer science, data science or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in data analytics, business intelligence, AI, or information systems roles in industry


In addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.


In addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in business analytics and applied AI education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to artificial intelligence and data-driven business applications
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate international data and AI projects into teaching and research.
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in business analytics, applied AI, or data engineering for enterprises
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society


What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours with core working hours – medical appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are no problem
  • Fixed salary + performance-based bonus + €100 per month (for full-time employees) towards a company pension plan after 6 months + 15% employer contribution to your own payments + attractive employee discounts
  • 1 additional day of paid leave per year for volunteering
  • Annual health budget of €600 (for full-time employees) after 6 months + access to more than 13,000 fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation


Application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *:
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations
    • If applicable, list of third-party funding acquisitions
    • If applicable, list of international experience and cooperations
  • Application documents must be submitted as scans. Please use the upload fields provided in the online portal. For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.
  • The recognition of foreign educational qualifications requires proof of equivalence. Initial points of contact can be found via the portal www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de or https://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung.
  • Equal opportunity and diversity are actively promoted and practiced at VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung). This position is explicitly open to people of all genders (m/f/d). Applications from female scientists are expressly welcomed.
  • Application costs will not be reimbursed.
In the further course of the appointment procedure, candidates may be asked, upon request, to give a teaching session, outline a research project, and complete at least one interview.
By submitting your application documents, you consent to them being forwarded to the Appointment Committee. Within the appointment procedure, certain persons/committee members have the right to inspect the documents. These include members of the Presidential Board, the Senate, the University Council, and the Appointment Committee, as well as the sponsoring institution (velpTEC GmbH). Furthermore, the Officer for Equality and Diversity, where applicable the Officer for (Severe) Disability, and the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture have the right to inspect the application documents. data.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.


Job Summary

As a Senior Solution Consultant – ITSM, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them translate business and service management challenges into practical, scalable solutions built on Atlassian tools and industry best practices.

You will lead discovery and solution design, guide customers through ITSM transformation, and own the solution intent throughout delivery. Working closely with Technical Consultants, Technical Architects, Project Managers, Engagement Managers, and Sales, you will ensure solutions remain feasible, aligned with customer needs, and focused on measurable outcomes.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

Discover & Advise

  • Lead discovery and scoping workshops to understand customer objectives, pain points, processes, constraints, maturity, and desired outcomes
  • Analyze and challenge existing service management processes and recommend practical improvements based on ITSM and Atlassian leading practices
  • Translate customer requirements into solution themes, priorities, success measures, and implementation considerations
  • Advise customers across ITSM practices such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management, service portals, and service operations
  • Facilitate conversations with business and technical stakeholders and identify where additional specialist expertise is required

    • Design & Shape Solutions

    • Translate business needs into high-level solution designs, roadmaps, configuration blueprints, and implementation-ready recommendations
    • Design scalable ITSM solutions leveraging Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian ecosystem
    • Produce clear deliverables including discovery outputs, current-state and future-state process maps, Solution Design Documents, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability
    • Document assumptions, dependencies, design decisions, trade-offs, and unresolved questions to maintain a shared understanding of the solution
    • Collaborate with Technical Consultants and Technical Architects to validate feasibility, scalability, integrations, automation, reporting, and platform constraints

      • Own & Guide Delivery

      • Own the solution intent throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring requirements, design decisions, acceptance criteria, and business outcomes remain visible during delivery

        • Build and maintain trusted customer relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle
        • Identify opportunities for optimization, expansion, or follow-on advisory work and collaborate with the appropriate Sales or Engagement owner

          • Share knowledge and leading practices across the Solution Consulting and wider Delivery teams
          • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, documentation, synthesis, quality review, and knowledge reuse while ensuring outputs remain accurate and customer-specific
          • Stay current with developments across the Atlassian ecosystem and trends in ITSM, ESM, Agile, Work Management, automation, reporting, and enterprise collaboration
          • Maintain and develop your expertise through continuous learning and relevant certifications
 

Do You Have What It Takes?

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Significant experience in ITSM consulting, solution consulting, or service management transformation
  • Strong knowledge of Jira Service Management and the Atlassian ecosystem
  • Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery, requirements, and solution design workshops

  • Experience producing high-quality customer-facing solution documentation, process maps, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to balance customer expectations, business outcomes, platform capabilities, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Experience collaborating with technical consultants, architects, project managers, and commercial teams
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of less experienced consultants
  • Atlassian and/or ITIL certifications are a plus

    • Ability to engage confidently with both business and technical stakeholders
    • Consultative mindset with the ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions
    • Ability to simplify complex requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions
    • Strong sense of ownership while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams
    • Proactive and pragmatic approach to solving customer challenges
    • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables

data.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

  • Own the architectural strategy for our Kubernetes-based clusters and broader hybrid infrastructure, setting the technical standards and guardrails within which the team designs, builds and operates.

  • Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

  • Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers.

  • Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments.

  • Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems.

  • Strong hands-on operational experience. You have participated in on-call rotations for production infrastructure, led responses to significant incidents and driven the subsequent changes required to prevent recurrence.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving.

  • Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines.

  • A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms.

  • Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Experience:

  • Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment.

 

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

 

Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

data.title: Head EMEA Refund Fraud, Integrity - Fixed Term Contract
data.description:
About the Role

The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace.

You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers.

This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment.

You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy

    • Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap.

    • Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.

    • Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest.

    • Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls.

    • Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments.

  2. Owning Performance and Risk

    • Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails.

    • Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost.

    • Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions.

    • Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken.

    • Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats.

  3. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities

    • Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys.

    • Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place.

    • Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions.

    • Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails.

    • Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention.

    • Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value.

  4. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment

    • Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams.

    • Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line.

    • Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension.

    • Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus.

    • Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact.

    • Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

  5. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

    • Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals.

    • Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members.

    • Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction.

    • Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks.

    • Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs.

    • Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions.

    • Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring:

  • Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years.

  • Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects.

  • A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon.

  • Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences.

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance.

  • Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions.

  • Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions.

  • Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations.

Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it.

What Success Looks Like

  • In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities.

  • You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities.

  • You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

data.description:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We're actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. You'll build and scale the lifecycle systems that drive retention, upsell, and customer lifetime value for millions of everyday earners across Africa.

The Impact 💚

You'll design the retention and upsell infrastructure that turns first-time customers into long-term, high-value ones, driving measurable CLV growth while creating financial inclusion for Africa's traditionally excluded. We've already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Build lifecycle CRM from the ground up: design and scale retention, repayment, and upsell programmes across 4 African markets (Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana), working with proprietary data from millions of customers and a unique distribution model (30,000+ field agents + 300 telesales)

💰 Own retention and upsell outcomes: your success is measured in CLV growth, retention and renewal rates, repayment behaviour, and upsell revenue

🎲 Bring fresh thinking: we want someone who pushes lifecycle beyond the standard playbook, gamification, loyalty mechanics, streaks, rewards, and other creative growth levers that make repayment and engagement genuinely enjoyable, not just another push notification

🎯 Nice to have, not required: we're curious whether you've also touched performance or paid marketing. We don't run that as part of Growth today, but understanding how it connects to retention is something we're actively thinking about, and your perspective could help shape where we take it

🚀 Go hands-on daily: build automated journeys, design experiments, analyse results, and scale what works

🏆 Global recognition: join a company named by TIME 100 as one of the world's most influential and by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing for 5 consecutive years (2022-2026)

What You'll Do

You'll own lifecycle CRM strategy and execution end to end. Build automated customer journeys in CleverTap, run experiments on messaging and timing, analyse retention and repayment cohorts, and scale successful programmes across markets. Partner with Product, Commercial, and Operations teams to turn customer behaviour into retention and growth opportunities.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Build and scale multi-channel lifecycle programmes: design onboarding, retention, churn prevention, and upsell journeys across SMS, WhatsApp, push, and in-app messaging

  • Design behavioural trigger-based upsell systems: move customers from entry products (smartphones/e-bikes) to higher-value bundles (digital loans, insurance, device protection) based on payment behaviour and engagement signals

  • Run rigorous experiments: A/B test messaging, timing, incentives, and offers with clear hypotheses and statistical rigour, then turn wins into repeatable playbooks

  • Own retention economics: track and optimise LTV, cohort retention, renewal rates, and upsell performance, translating insights into action

  • Scale what works across markets: turn successful experiments into documented frameworks that enable teams to execute retention initiatives across 4 African markets

Your Environment 💼

Tech Stack: CleverTap, Braze, MoEngage, or similar

Analytics: Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker

Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging, telesales

What You Need

  • 6+ years building and scaling CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in businesses where daily or weekly customer engagement drives retention and revenue.

  • You've built CRM systems, not just optimised them, whether migrating platforms (Mailchimp → Braze), designing journey architecture from scratch, or scaling programmes across markets.

  • You're hands-on in CRM platforms daily, personally building journeys in tools like Braze, CleverTap, MoEngage, Customer.io, or Iterable.

  • You think in business outcomes, your achievements mention LTV growth, retention revenue, upsell rates, renewal improvements, not just open rates or engagement metrics.

  • You run rigorous experiments, designing tests with clear hypotheses, control groups, and measurable success criteria.

  • You bring fresh eyes to lifecycle marketing, someone who's introduced gamification, loyalty programmes, streaks, badges, or other non-obvious engagement mechanics into a retention strategy, and can talk about what worked, what didn't, and why.

  • Relevant backgrounds we're interested in: MVNO experience, super-apps with daily engagement models, mobile gaming with daily retention mechanics, prepaid subscription services, or B2C fintech/subscription businesses where high-frequency engagement drives the model.

  • Bonus, not required: exposure to performance or paid marketing (paid social, paid search, app install campaigns), and a point of view on how acquisition spend and targeting could connect to retention outcomes. This isn't something you'd own, we're just genuinely interested in how you think about it.

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

 

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.
